2026 CONTRACT RATES/KENYA/ACCOMODATION/MUTHU HOTELS/MUTHU HOTELS - SUNWORLD SAFARIS - 2026 Contract Rates.pdf
notes: This single Sunworld contract covers 4 MGM Muthu properties (Keekorok Lodge, Lake Naivasha Country Club, Sovereign Suites & Spa, Silver Springs & Spa) - one JSON file written per property; shared terms (circuit/group discounts, cancellation, payment) repeated in each.
Identical PDF exists in both the 'MUTHU' and 'MUTHU HOTELS' folders (byte-for-byte same content confirmed by reading both) - a filing duplication, not a discrepancy.
52 Standard Rooms, 15 Premium Rooms, 20 Chalets, 10 Luxury Cottages, 1 Executive Suite, 1 Presidential Suite (3 bedrooms).
This is a distinct property from 'Muthu Mara River Lodge' (new opening promo, also in the MUTHU folder) - see muthu-mara-river-lodge-2026.json.

includes: 2 game drives per day, 2 hours each, sharing basis

childPolicy.raw: 0-5yrs sharing with parents free. 6-11yrs child sharing rate applies. Two children in own room: 75% of twin rate (per person). Three children in own room: full twin rate.

halfBoardReduction.raw: Applicable at Keekorok Lodge & Lake Naivasha Country Club - child 50%

circuitDiscounts.note: Must be indicated on booking voucher

groupDiscount.raw: 7.5% off applicable rate for 20+ rooms or 40+ guests on a single voucher. Not applicable in Peak/Festive season, not for >70% of property inventory, not for allotments.

famTripRate.raw: 50% discount off contract rate, subject to availability, not applicable Easter/Christmas/Peak

tourLeaderRates.raw: 1-6 paying pax: half twin rate. 7-14 paying pax: 50% of half twin rate. Complimentary: 1 per 15 paying guests, max 5 free, must be pre-booked.

policies.deposit: 20% non-refundable on proforma invoice to secure booking; further 50% non-refundable 90 days before arrival; balance 30 days before arrival. Peak/Festive: 30% then 45% then balance on same schedule.
